condition: Putting a tz-aware Timestamp whose year is outside 1-9999 into a Series, DatetimeIndex or to_datetime result silently changes its year to 1970 or 1972.
workaround: Build the array from tz-naive values first, then localize the whole array (for example, pd.Series([ts.tz_localize(None)]).dt.tz_localize("UTC")).
